annotations.title: Stripe Dispute Evidence UTF-16 & CE 3.0 Completeness Linter

description: Deterministically lint a Stripe dispute evidence[access_activity_log] payload against Stripe's 18,000 UTF-16 code unit (String.prototype.length) ceiling, UTF-8 byte length, non-destructive --- BEGIN REVCLAMP CE3 EVIDENCE --- / --- END REVCLAMP CE3 EVIDENCE --- delimiter markers, existing merchant note preservation, and Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 (CE 3.0) prior-charge (>= 2) + IP/device overlap qualification. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, lint, utf16CodeUnits, maxUtf16Ceiling, remainingUtf16Units, withinCeiling, utf8Bytes, nonDestructiveMarkersPresent, merchantNotesPreserved, priorMatchedCount, hasIpMatch, hasDeviceMatch, ce3RubricPassed, and overallVerdict.

evidenceLogText.description: Merged or candidate Stripe dispute evidence[access_activity_log] payload evaluated against the 18,000 UTF-16 code unit ceiling and non-destructive delimiter markers.

existingMerchantNotes.description: Existing human AE/support notes inside evidence[access_activity_log] that must be preserved.

hasDeviceMatch.description: Whether the disputed charge device_id fingerprint matches the historical undisputed charges.

hasIpMatch.description: Whether the disputed charge IPv4/IPv6 address matches the historical undisputed charges.

preset.description: Scenario preset to evaluate when custom evidenceLogText is omitted (default: 'valid_ce3_non_destructive').

priorMatchedCount.description: Number of prior undisputed Stripe charges (120d-365d old) with matching customer_id and IP/device fingerprint (Visa CE 3.0 requires >= 2).
